items.objective: In `src/candidate.cpp`, isolate the unfused single-timestep kernel and contiguous-x line traversal. Compare the existing scalar formulation with compiler-vectorizable and, only if supported by the frozen build, explicit SIMD formulations; do not change compiler flags or assume an ISA extension. Account for the interior start offset despite aligned inputs. Keep threading and spatial/temporal blocking out of scope. Preserve numerical tolerance and boundaries; validate and measure the kernel under the official settings.
